entries.title: What's new
entries.summary: A page that lists what was released, by date, module or user, with a link to how to use each one.
entries.detail: Days are open to start with and can be folded. Choose View by to group the list by date, module, user, or module and user. Select More for a short longer text and How to use for the guide page.

entries.title: User journeys
entries.summary: Readers pick the kind of user they are and follow the guides they need, in order.
entries.detail: Nothing is hidden: Everyone still shows the whole guide. Journeys are written from the app's own user types.

entries.title: Smarter update checks
entries.summary: A check compares each page with everything that changed after its own last update, and keeps findings nobody applied yet.

entries.title: Admin locked during setup
entries.summary: Setup now locks the admin behind Cloudflare Access for you.
